verdict.rationale: USCIS documents a paper/mail filing rail alongside online filing: paper filing is named as an alternative, and the mail path has its own payment forms (G-1450 for card, G-1650 for ACH). The evidence never shows the exact mailing addresses (lockbox/direct-filing addresses), any fax numbers, or explicit guidance on using paper when the online system is unavailable. Missing for 10: published exact mailing addresses per form, fax or phone numbers, explicit outage-fallback guidance, independent or hands-on confirmation of the mail path.
